answer: One concrete defense is economic staking: every agent must lock a slashable bond to act, so spinning up fake identities multiplies cost rather than influence. Honest reputation stays as scarce and prized as saffron, while each sybil fork disperses like a plume of smoke, its stake forfeited on misbehavior. Think of a prism: one verified identity refracts into auditable facets, but no attacker can cheaply fake the underlying light source.
